meta.name: The Practice — Auth desk (paper & ink)
meta.description: Login/register desk: a warmer cream slip of paper on a ruled notebook pad. Editorial serif + typewriter labels, charcoal SIGN IN, terracotta accent, analog grain — not SaaS glass.

primary.role: Ink / primary action fill (SIGN IN) and display type on paper

secondary.role: Warmer card stock sitting on the pad

accent.role: Terracotta stamp, margin line, and text links (Create one)

neutral.usage: Lightest #eae5da is the pad (background). #e3d8c9 is the auth sheet. #ccc1b3 is ruling, hairlines, and Google outline. #b4a290 is the faint watermark P and overline labels. #6f685b is lede and secondary copy. #252421 is foreground type and the primary button — the measured text role.

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant: charcoal ink on cream paper; accent used sparingly as a single editorial mark

font_families.heading: Source Serif 4 Variable, Source Serif 4, Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif
font_families.body: Newsreader Variable, Newsreader, Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif
font_families.mono: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: High-contrast old-style serif for brand and headlines (Welcome back); quieter text serif for lede and footer links; IBM Plex Mono all-caps overlines (EMAIL, PASSWORD, OR, SIGN IN) as the typewriter desk. Watermark P is the same display serif at huge scale, very faint. Do not substitute Inter or geometric sans for headlines.

spacing.section_rhythm: Stacked title page: brand lockup, then a large gap into the heading, a short lede, then a second gap into the form. Fields sit on a 20–24px vertical cadence. SIGN IN is full-bleed of the text column. Footer links get another generous gap before Back to the editor.

layout.grid_system: Single centered column; no sidebar. The pad is full-bleed; the sheet is a portrait card in the column.
layout.breakpoints: Sheet padding 28px → 36px from ~640px; Night toggle stays top-right of the viewport; watermark scales down on small screens.

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px on the Google outline only; SIGN IN is fill with no stroke; inputs have no box, only an underline
shape.divider_style: Hairline #ccc1b3, 1px. Form fields are underlines. OR is a broken rule with the word in the gap. Left pad margin is a vertical terracotta rule at ~10% from the left edge.

levels.medium: 0 24px 48px -16px color-mix(in srgb, #252421 24%, transparent), 0 8px 18px -10px color-mix(in srgb, #252421 12%, transparent)

elevation.depth_cues: A second sheet of warmer paper on the pad: color shift (#eae5da pad vs #e3d8c9 card) plus a soft drop shadow. No glass, no glow.

iconography.style: Physical stamp: double-square frame, slightly rotated (~-7°), filled terracotta with a white pilcrow. Google G is the vendor mark, not restyled. Decorative / and hollow square on the pad are faint editorial marks, not a UI icon set.
iconography.preferred_set: Custom AppMark (pilcrow stamp) plus the official Google G; no Lucide/Heroicons on this screen

motion.entrance_pattern: Calm fade-up of lockup then form (~40ms / 90ms stagger). Pad ink washes and ruled lines drift extremely slowly.
motion.exit_pattern: Instant dismiss of the paper veil when the desk is ready; no bounce.
motion.philosophy: minimal functional — analog stillness. Motion is paper settling, not UI chrome.

components.button_style: Primary: full-width charcoal #252421 rectangle, sharp corners, white IBM Plex Mono uppercase tracking ~0.15em, ~12px vertical padding. Hover implied: fill shifts toward terracotta. Secondary: paper-white / #eae5da fill, 1px #ccc1b3 stroke, Google G + sans label — do not fake GIS with a custom button if the live app uses GIS.
components.input_style: Unboxed. Overline label EMAIL/PASSWORD in mono. Transparent field, 1px #ccc1b3 underline. Focus: vermilion/terracotta underline grows from center. No filled well, no inner shadow.
components.card_style: Portrait cream slip (~8px radius), warmer than the pad, 1px hairline optional, grain overlay, generous padding ~36–44px. Not a nested dashboard card.
components.navigation_pattern: No masthead. Night is a single serif word, top-right of the pad. Brand lockup links home. Footer: Create one (accent underline) and Back to the editor (faint underline).
components.modal_style: If a blocking state is needed (desk waking): full-viewport paper veil — same cream at ~82% over a 6% ink mist — with a 1px terracotta hairline and mono status. Not a dialog box, not glass.
components.list_style: Not present. If needed later: ruled lines, not bordered rows.
components.component_notes: This frame is a title page, not an app shell. Keep AppMark as the pilcrow stamp even if the render garbles a white P. Accent coverage is tiny (~0.27%) — do not flood terracotta. #789ec8 is the Google G, not a brand blue.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A cream notebook pad with a smaller sheet of writing paper laid on top — stationery, not a login modal.
aesthetic.era_influence: Mid-century academic journal + legal pad; contemporary product type (Source Serif, IBM Plex Mono).

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous interior padding and stacked gaps; the pad around the sheet is open field, not empty marketing hero.
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Weight sits in the charcoal SIGN IN bar and the Welcome back headline. The pad is light. Accent is a pinprick.
visual_language.contrast_level: High type contrast (ink on cream) with low chrome contrast (rules and watermark almost disappear).
visual_language.texture_usage: Paper grain across pad and sheet; watercolor ink stains at corners; horizontal notebook ruling; vermilion left margin.

composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom, left-aligned copy inside a centered sheet
composition.grouping_strategy: Lockup → heading/lede → fields → primary action → OR/Google → account switch → back link
composition.negative_space_role: The pad is the margin of the notebook. Space inside the sheet is leading between type, not card-in-card padding.

imagery.illustration_style: Ink wash and a giant ghost monogram, as if the paper itself were printed
graphic_elements: small slash and stamp marks on the pad
imagery.pattern_usage: Repeating 28px ruled lines plus one margin line — ledger, not a tech grid
imagery.image_shape: Full-bleed pad; the sheet is a tall rounded rectangle

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Quiet ink: underline turns terracotta, primary fill can shift toward accent, links already underlined.
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Type and fill recolor; no lift, no scale-up, no glow.
interaction_feel.loading_style: Not shown in the frame. Desk-waking copy with a vermilion hairline on a full-page paper veil — analog, not a spinner.
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: Sparse. One focus underline, one hover on the primary, Night toggle. No badges, no pills.

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Calm literary English. Short sentences. No growth-speak.
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: Quietly formal — a desk, not a chatbot.
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Your papers and talks are waiting. — the work already exists; you return to it.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Plain and brief, in the voice of a proofreader, not a system alert. Vermilion, not a red banner.

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS: keep ruling, margin, and sheet; freeze ink-wash drift and grain if motion is reduced

background_effects.description: Full-bleed cream pad with SVG fractal-noise grain, repeating horizontal rules, a terracotta margin line, and three soft radial ink washes (charcoal and terracotta) in the corners. A huge translucent serif P occupies the top-right.
background_effects.technology: CSS gradients + SVG feTurbulence grain overlay

params.density: low — grain opacity ~0.45 multiply; rules ~0.3 opacity
params.blend_mode: multiply on grain; washes are normal radial gradients

particle_systems.description: No particles. Ink stains are gradients, not emitters.

shader_effects.description: Paper grain is an SVG turbulence filter, not a GLSL shader. Do not add WebGL noise.

scroll_morphing.description: Auth is a single locked viewport; no scroll morph.

text_effects.description: Type is static ink. Watermark P is opacity, not a text effect.

cursor_effects.description: System cursor. No trail, no magnetic stamp.

image_effects.description: No photos to treat. Grain applies to the sheet surface, not to imagery.

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas. Grain and washes are CSS/SVG.

svg_animations.description: The stamp and slash may float 2–4px over tens of seconds in the live app; the reference frame is still. Prefer CSS keyframes over SMIL.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Screenshot-only: analog stationery stack. Pad (#eae5da) + sheet (#e3d8c9) + charcoal action (#252421) + terracotta accent (#b07657). A full-page waking overlay should be vellum of the same paper (not blur-glass, not a dimmer over just the form). Do not introduce purple, glow, or glass. Measured accent is rustier and paler than the live Folio vermilion #c14324 — keep #b07657 if matching this frame; keep #c14324 if matching the live brand stamp. #789ec8 is Google G contamination, coverage 0.0001 — never a theme color.
